svg.title: Diptych: Green Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Observed horizontal gap is diagrammatic; gallery overall dimensions are retained, installation spacing may vary.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-last-paintings-05-2017/lightbox/works/diptych-green-blue-2015-42883; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
